title: ION826
summary: ION826 jfrazier@ionis.com Fri, 01/30/2026 - 13:58 Drug Name ION826 Target PLN Disease Myocardial Disease Description ION826, also known as AZD4063, is an investigational siRNA medicine in development for a serious form of myocardial disease called PLN-R14del dilated cardiomyopathy. ION826 uses Bicycle® technology, a Bicycle peptide ligand with high affinity to the transferrin receptor (TFR1) to deliver antisense medicines to muscle tissue, including in the heart. It is the first Bicycle-conjugated siRNA to reach clinical trials. This program is partnered with AstraZeneca. About PLN R14del dilated cardiomyopathy PLN-R14del dilated cardiomyopathy is a serious form of myocardial disease caused by a mutation in the phospholamban (PLN) gene, where the arginine at position 14 (R14del) is deleted. With no approved disease-modifying therapies, people living with the PLNR14del mutation are at higher risk of heart muscle weakening, malignant ventricular arrhythmias and heart failure. Safety and efficacy have not been evaluated by any regulatory authorities for the indication described. Partner AstraZeneca Phase 1 Phase one Therapeutic Area Cardiometabolic Disease Display Order 4
